summary: Built the Contract Tracker screen: TrackerPage (route /tracker, role-gated to Tenant Admin / Contract Owner / Legal Reviewer / Approver with redirect to the existing /access-denied screen for every other role, e.g. Signer/External Party) matching IMG-1 closely -- breadcrumb Home Page / CLM Hub / Tracker, 'Contract Tracker' header with Export button top-right, Filters panel, and a four-tab bar (Ownership, Cycle Time, Bottleneck, Turnaround) defaulting to Ownership. TrackerReportControlsPanel renders Period (mandatory: Daily/Weekly/Monthly), Contract Type Filter and Owner Filter (optional, 'All' plus tenant lookups), and Date Range From/To with From-before-To validation (UC10-FV-001). OwnershipTab renders the Contracts by Owner table (Owner Name, Contracts Owned, In Draft, In Negotiation, In Approval, In Signature, Completed) with a period-window caption ('Weekly view — last 7 days', etc., per UC10-BR-006). CycleTimeTab renders a per-stage average-cycle-time bar chart plus a grouped table, showing 'Not available' when a stage has no completed contracts (UC10-BR-001). BottleneckTab renders Current Stage/Days in Current Stage/Stuck Flag with a Yes/No badge, plus the tenant's configured stuck-flag thresholds when viewed as Tenant Admin (UC10-BR-002). TurnaroundTab renders Contract Name/Type/Estimated/Actual/Variance with red/green color coding (UC10-BR-003), 'Not Set' display and average-exclusion for contracts with no target completion date (UC10-BR-004), an 'AI Suggested' badge, and an inline override control that logs original value/new value/user/timestamp (UC10-BR-007). TrackerExportButton triggers POST /tracker/export for the active tab/period/filters and shows 'Export failed. Please try again.' on failure without disturbing the current view or active tab (UC10-AF-004). Per UC10-BR-013 the screen has no persisted object state: Period, filters and the active Tab all reset to their defaults (Weekly / All / Ownership) via trackerFiltersSlice.resetOnOpen() on every mount. Four tab-data hooks, an export hook and an override hook were added, one new service module (trackerService.js) wired to exactly the seven listed endpoints, and a new store slice (trackerFiltersSlice). Lint, the full 131-test suite (5 new tests), and the production build all pass. Visually verified against IMG-1 via a temporary local mock backend + Playwright screenshot at 1440x900 (removed before finishing) -- the Ownership tab (the only state the design depicts) is a close match: breadcrumb, header, Export button placement, Filters card layout and helper copy, tab bar, and the Contracts by Owner table's exact columns and row data all line up.

code_files.description: Top-level Tracker screen: breadcrumb/header/Export, Tenant-Admin/Contract-Owner/Legal-Reviewer/Approver-only access guard redirecting to /access-denied, Filters panel, four-tab navigation, and orchestration of all four tabs' data hooks plus export/override handlers.
Period dropdown (mandatory), Contract Type Filter and Owner Filter (optional, tenant lookups plus All), and Date Range From/To with From-earlier-than-To validation.
Export trigger button that shows the 'Export failed. Please try again.' message on failure without touching the current view.
Contracts by Owner table (Owner Name, Contracts Owned, In Draft, In Negotiation, In Approval, In Signature, Completed) with loading/error/empty/populated states and a period-window caption.
Average Cycle Time per stage bar chart and grouped (stage/owner/contract type) table, showing 'Not available' when a stage has no completed contracts.
Current Stage / Days in Current Stage / Stuck Flag table with a Yes/No badge, plus the tenant's configured stuck-flag thresholds caption for Tenant Admin.
Contract Name/Type, Estimated/Actual Turnaround, Variance table with red/green color coding, 'Not Set' + AI Suggested labelling, and an inline Estimated Turnaround override control.
Shared fetch-on-filter-change implementation used by the four per-tab hooks below.
Fetches Ownership tab data.
Fetches Cycle Time tab data.
Fetches Bottleneck tab data.
Fetches Turnaround tab data.
Triggers a Tracker export and surfaces the failure message without disturbing the caller's current view.
Submits an override of an AI-suggested Estimated Turnaround value.
Populates the Contract Type Filter / Owner Filter dropdowns from the tenant's real lookup data (reuses GET /api/v1/dashboard/filters -- see blockers).
Fetches the tenant-configured stuck-flag thresholds per stage for Tenant Admin viewers only (the endpoint is Tenant-Admin-scoped).
Typed client for the seven /api/v1/tracker endpoints: ownership, cycle-time, bottleneck, turnaround, export, estimated-override, bottleneck-thresholds.
Period/filter/activeTab state with resetOnOpen(), matching the trackerFiltersSlice contract; the Tracker has no persisted object state of its own (UC10-BR-013).

Screen-level tests: default Ownership tab render, access-denial redirect for a disallowed role, tab switching to Bottleneck's empty state, export failure message without losing the table data, and Date-Range-From/To validation.
Adds the /tracker route for TrackerPage.

pr.title: feat(tracker): build TrackerPage with Ownership/Cycle Time/Bottleneck/Turnaround tabs
pr.body:
Implements the Contract Tracker screen (UC10-AF-002 / UC10-MF-001 and the full UC10-AF/BR/FV/GC set listed in the task): a Tenant Admin / Contract Owner / Legal Reviewer / Approver screen at /tracker with four reporting tabs.

- Role-gated: Signer, External Party and any other role are redirected to the existing /access-denied screen before any Tracker content renders (UC10-AF-002 / UC10-BR-012).
- TrackerReportControlsPanel: mandatory Period (Daily/Weekly/Monthly), optional Contract Type Filter and Owner Filter (tenant lookups plus All), Date Range From/To with From-before-To validation (UC10-FV-001).
- Ownership tab: Contracts by Owner table (Owner Name, Contracts Owned, In Draft, In Negotiation, In Approval, In Signature, Completed) with a period-window caption.
- Cycle Time tab: average-cycle-time bar chart and grouped table, 'Not available' when a stage has no completions (UC10-BR-001).
- Bottleneck tab: Current Stage / Days in Current Stage / Stuck Flag with a Yes/No badge and the tenant's configured thresholds for Tenant Admin (UC10-BR-002).
- Turnaround tab: Contract Name/Type/Estimated/Actual/Variance with red/green color coding, 'Not Set' + AI Suggested labelling and an auditable override control (UC10-BR-003/004/007).
- Export: POST /tracker/export for the active tab/period/filters, with an inline failure message that never disturbs the current view (UC10-AF-004).
- No persisted state: Period, filters and the active tab reset to their defaults on every open (UC10-BR-013).

One new service module (7 endpoints), 8 new hooks, one new store slice, and a new page-level test (5 cases). Lint, the full 131-test suite, and the production build all pass. Visually verified against IMG-1 via a local mock backend + Playwright screenshot at 1440x900 (temporary harness, removed before commit) -- a close match on breadcrumb, header, Export placement, Filters layout/copy, tab bar, and the Ownership table's exact columns and data.

blockers: Missing lookup endpoint (inferred, not invented): UC10-FV-001 requires the Contract Type Filter / Owner Filter dropdowns to be populated from 'the tenant's configured contract types/users' (matching the design's helper copy 'Tenant's configured contract types, plus All' / 'Tenant users with owned contracts, plus All'), but this module's endpoint contract lists no tracker-specific options endpoint. Rather than inventing a new URL, useTrackerFilterOptions.js reuses the already-built GET /api/v1/dashboard/filters (from the uc123 module, which returns contractTypes[] and owners[{id,name}][]) since it is the closest existing real lookup and CLAUDE.md forbids inline constants for filter options. If the backend intends a tracker-scoped lookup instead, this call site is the one place to repoint.

Inferred response shape: the contract's BottleneckThresholdResponse DTO is declared as a single {stage, thresholdDays} object, but the endpoint summary says 'per stage' (plural) and BR-2 clearly needs all four stages' thresholds at once. useBottleneckThresholds.js treats the response as (or unwraps) an array of that shape; confirm the actual envelope with the backend.

Design/story tension (story wins, per instructions): IMG-1 only depicts the Ownership tab, so the Cycle Time/Bottleneck/Turnaround tabs' exact column layout, bar-chart styling and the Turnaround override UI were built from the DTO fields and acceptance criteria (UC10-GC-002/003/004, UC10-BR-007) rather than from a screenshot. These three tabs were verified functionally (loading/error/empty/populated states, color coding, tab-switch) but not against a pixel design, since none was provided.

Judgement call: the Export Button in IMG-1 sits in the page header (not inside the Filters card), so TrackerExportButton is rendered in TrackerPage's header rather than inside TrackerReportControlsPanel, even though context.json's component prop list ties onFilterChange/Export concerns to the same panel area. This matches the screenshot's actual placement.

Judgement call: UC10-BR-007's 'Estimated Turnaround override' control (value edit + Save/Cancel inline in the Turnaround row) was inferred from the acceptance criteria and EstimatedTurnaroundOverrideRequest DTO, since no design shows this interaction; overriddenBy/overrideTimestamp are populated client-side from the current session's X-User-Id and the current time, per the DTO's required fields.

No endpoint exists in this module's contract to fetch a single contract's role-assignment/approver-list (needed to fully implement BR-005/009/010/011 role-scoping on the frontend); this is a backend-side filtering concern given the endpoints all accept only period/contractTypeFilter/ownerFilter/date-range params and return already-scoped rows, so no additional frontend code was added for it beyond trusting the API's role-scoped response.
